name: Casas de Don Gómez (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of yellow, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Casas de Don Gómez (a tower, a cross of Alcántara and a tree).
history: The arms and the flag of Casas de Don Gómez were approved by the Order of 2 March 1994 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 12 March 1994, after the municipal council's approval on 30 September 1993.

features.role: Casas de Don Gómez arms — tower, cross of Alcántara and tree
